outcome: Intestinal flora (richness, diversity, structure, specific phyla/genera)
Fecal metabolites (glyceric acid, succinic acid, phenylalanine, cadaverine)
cohort: The participants are neonates with breast milk jaundice and jaundice-free breastfeeding newborns.
finding: Neonates with breast milk jaundice exhibited an immature intestinal flora colonization status, characterized by structural differences including higher Proteobacteria and lower Firmicutes, along with significant differences in fecal metabolites such as glyceric acid, succinic acid, and phenylalanine, where *Escherichia* was positively correlated with succinic acid and cadaverine levels.
